honest_read: Closer on the leaf (ratchet edges, chunky two-lobed rear assembly, deep slot), the rolled block transitions and the rounded front. Still a likely pick: much of this crop is the dust cover (smooth cylinder, no stepped crown) and the charging handle (plain box), both owned by receiver_right; the block still reads bulkier and its top more visible than the drawing's (c2's stylised proportions vs the side view's stations, which win; camera residual 8.7 px RMS); c2 and q34 draw the retainer link less steep than the side view's 45 deg; and the render is clean CG next to a painted, worn drawing.
outside_this_module: dust cover crown / stepped edges and the recoil spring guide button (receiver_right)
